candidates.title: The argument with a stranger
candidates.rationale: Opens with a story, sets up the belief, and lands on «полнейшая чушь». Needs no context.

candidates.title: God lost, the devil won
candidates.rationale: The most quotable passage in the recording: a 95/5 arithmetic that ends on «идиотизм». Stands alone completely.

candidates.title: God caught off guard
candidates.rationale: The comic beat — God saying «ой-ой-ой, что же делать» in Eden, then improvising «план Б». Self-contained and funny.

candidates.title: Where is free will?
candidates.rationale: Opens on a clean topic sentence and closes on a rhetorical question that works as an ending.
